summary_1line: Dhritarashtra praises Krishna’s divine nature while Yudhishthira laments injustice and argues for peace over war despite Kshatriya duty.

image_candidates.scene_text: Blind king Dhritarashtra sits in his palace imagining the radiant Krishna whose brilliance illuminates all directions.
Yudhishthira stands before Krishna in the Pandava camp, humbly asking for only five villages to avoid a devastating war.
Krishna listens calmly as Yudhishthira speaks about the misery of poverty and the tragedy of kin killing kin in battle.
